on: Behind the stand. Make each glass the ticket shows.
idle: Nobody is waiting yet. The stand is open.
front: Fig Jr.’s lemonade stand. Ask Fig Jr. for a job and you can pour lemonade here for tips.
left: Somebody got tired of waiting and walked off without a glass.

receipt.title: Lemonade stand receipt
receipt.none: No glasses went out this shift, so no tips.
receipt.capped: Glasses went out, but today’s tips were all earned. They still count for work XP.

perfect: Spot on at every step. That glass tips more.
Every step in the middle of the green band: a bigger tip.
Spot on. The middle of the green band tips best.
Right in the middle, every step. A bigger tip for it.
fine: A good glass. Stop in the middle of the green band for a bigger tip.
Served, with a small tip. The middle of the green band tips more.
A good glass. Dead centre on each green band earns more.
Good enough for a small tip. Aim for the middle of the green band.
wrong: A step missed the green band. They take it, but leave no tip.
Not quite right. They take the glass, but leave no tip.
That one missed the green band, so no tip for it.
Outside the green band: they take it without a tip.

big: A big glass. Hold the squeeze a little longer for this one.

jug.offer: Nobody waiting: fill the jug, and the next glasses skip the squeeze.
jug.full: The jug is full. The next three glasses skip the squeeze.
jug.spilt: The jug spills over. Try again in the next quiet moment.

tipsAll: That’s today’s tips all earned. Glasses still count for work XP.
